title: Ike's Morning Digest
data_note: Built from publisher RSS metadata (titles + teaser text). `coverage_window_hours` is the default (40h); several feeds use a longer `rollingHours` (see `scripts/build-digest.mjs`) so rows align with what is still on each publisher’s listing pages. Commercial Observer keeps its retail category + hub supplement; TRD adds a New York–filtered global retail tag feed. PincusCo uses the live site feed only (`/category/retail/feed/` is stale). **CRE Daily** retail briefs come from `credaily.com/sectors/retail/feed/`. **WSJ** is the Dow Jones real-estate feed with lifestyle and opinion dropped. **The New York Times** keeps real-estate and property stories only. **Traded** is commercial deal briefs from its news listing. Open each link for the full article (subscriptions may apply in the browser).

section_overviews.commercial_observer:
Italian Kitchen Manufacturer Officine Gullo to Open Store at 95 Madison Avenue: Hey now, hey now , these kitchens are what dreams are made of. Italy’s Officine Gullo , a manufacturer of luxury commercial and residential kitchens, has taken 3,200 square feet of ground-floor retail space at Sunlight Development ’s 95 Madison Avenue in Manhattan’s NoMad neighborhood, Commercial Observer has learned.

Snowflake Spa to Open New Location at 619 Ninth Avenue in Hell’s Kitchen: It’s giving self-care vibes. Snowflake Spa , a massage therapy and wellness provider, is getting ready to open another location in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood at 619 Ninth Avenue .

PNC Bank Inks 4K-SF Retail Lease at 312 West 43rd Street: Residents at the Ellery , a mixed-use residential development in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood, are getting another retailer at the base of their 33-story home. PNC Bank has signed a 3,500-square-foot retail lease at the base of the property at 312 West 43rd Street , according to co-developers and co-owners.

Barings Buys SoCal Grocery-Anchored Shopping Center for $66M: Investment management firm Barings has put down $66.2 million to acquire a fully leased grocery-anchored shopping center in Orange County, Calif. First Washington Realty sold the Village Center at Rose , a 118,876-square-foot retail property at 600-858 North Rose Drive in Placentia, Calif., CBRE announced Monday.

Institutions Turn to JVs for Grocery-Anchored Retail: Institutional investors are using joint ventures to gain exposure to retail, especially grocery-anchored centers, citing supply-and-demand fundamentals and long-term income growth.

Grocery-Anchored Retail Premium Hinges on Store and Lease: Grocery-anchored retail is among the most competitive investment niches, with 2025 transaction volume near $11B and cap rates averaging 6.7%, but the grocery label alone doesn’t justify a premium.

Hines Says Retail Recovery Is an Income and Scarcity Call: Hines Research says retail pricing has recovered across open-air centers and enclosed malls in the U.S. and Europe, while lagging Asian markets could offer opportunity.

Mark IV Breaks Ground on 41,500 SF Round Rock Retail Plaza: Mark IV Capital broke ground in October on a 41,521 SF plaza at The District in Round Rock, with six single-story buildings and room for nine to 14 restaurant and lifestyle tenants.

The tenant inked a 10-year, 2,200-square-foot lease for ground-floor and basement retail space at the mixed-use property, tenant broker Lee & Associates NYC announced Wednesday.…

items.headline: PNC Bank Inks 4K-SF Retail Lease at 312 West 43rd Street
items.summary: Residents at the Ellery , a mixed-use residential development in Manhattan’s Hell’s Kitchen neighborhood, are getting another retailer at the base of their 33-story home. PNC Bank has signed a 3,500-square-foot retail lease at the base of the property at 312 West 43rd Street , according to co-developers and co-owners Taconic Partners and National Real Estate Advisors .…

items.headline: Barings Buys SoCal Grocery-Anchored Shopping Center for $66M
items.summary: Investment management firm Barings has put down $66.2 million to acquire a fully leased grocery-anchored shopping center in Orange County, Calif. First Washington Realty sold the Village Center at Rose , a 118,876-square-foot retail property at 600-858 North Rose Drive in Placentia, Calif., CBRE announced Monday. The transaction is equal to about $557 per square foot. The 10.15-acre shopping center was built 30 years ago at the northeast corner of North Rose Drive and Alta Vista Street.…

items.headline: Institutions Turn to JVs for Grocery-Anchored Retail
items.summary: Institutional investors are using joint ventures to gain exposure to retail, especially grocery-anchored centers, citing supply-and-demand fundamentals and long-term income growth. Investors want experienced operators with leasing, tenant-mix and local-market know-how, while operators get capital in return for acquisitions, development and redevelopment. JV equity is still hard to raise amid high rates, valuation uncertainty and buyer-seller gaps, so some investors are buying stakes in operating companies instead.…

items.headline: Grocery-Anchored Retail Premium Hinges on Store and Lease
items.summary: Grocery-anchored retail is among the most competitive investment niches, with 2025 transaction volume near $11B and cap rates averaging 6.7%, but the grocery label alone doesn’t justify a premium. Buyers should study store sales, the grocer’s competitive position and remodel plans, plus lease terms such as sales-based termination rights, co-tenancy clauses and replacement restrictions.…

items.headline: AT&T Renews 7K-SF Lease at Rudin’s 3 Times Square
items.summary: Home is where the heart is, and telecommunications giant AT&T is quite at home in the heart of Times Square . The wireless carrier has renewed and extended its lease at Rudin ’s 3 Times Square for another five years, Commercial Observer has learned. AT&T occupies 6,623 square feet of ground-floor and lower-level retail space at the 925,000-square-foot Midtown office tower . AT&T moved into the 30-story property, located on Seventh Avenue between West 42nd and West 43rd streets, in 2008.…

items.headline: Hines Says Retail Recovery Is an Income and Scarcity Call
items.summary: Hines Research says retail pricing has recovered across open-air centers and enclosed malls in the U.S. and Europe, while lagging Asian markets could offer opportunity. About 480M SF of U.S. retail has been demolished since 2000 and development has been slow for over a decade, which Hines calls an underappreciated supply story. Hines frames the opportunity as an income and scarcity call, with returns driven by leasing and execution, and grocery anchors worth about 25% above-market rents in Atlanta.…

items.headline: Mark IV Breaks Ground on 41,500 SF Round Rock Retail Plaza
items.summary: Mark IV Capital broke ground in October on a 41,521 SF plaza at The District in Round Rock, with six single-story buildings and room for nine to 14 restaurant and lifestyle tenants. The plaza is the project’s second vertical phase and is due in 2028, alongside the 316-unit Origin apartments that began construction in March with $86M in funding.…

items.headline: Carnegie Diner & Cafe Operator to Open New Restaurant at 7 Penn Plaza
items.summary: Carnegie Hospitality is opening its next Carnegie Diner & Cafe in Manhattan’s Penn District. The restaurateur signed on the dotted line last month to take over fast-casual chain Smashburger ’s lease at the Feil Organization ’s 7 Penn Plaza , Commercial Observer has learned. The tri-party deal included a 10-year lease extension for the 5,609-square-foot retail space at the corner of Seventh Avenue and West 31st Street.…

items.headline: Mexican Eatery Casa Carmen to Open Third Manhattan Location
items.summary: Mexican restaurant Casa Carmen is opening its third Manhattan location in Midtown East, Commercial Observer has learned. The restaurant concept started by chef Carmen “Titita” Ramírez Degollado signed a 15-year, 6,917-square-foot lease to serve up traditional Mexican cuisine at Sage ’s 437 Madison Avenue , according to tenant broker Retail by MONA as well as the landlord . Asking rent for the space was $200 per square foot, according to Retail by MONA.…

items.headline: PSP and Nuveen Launch $790M Grocery-Anchored Retail JV
items.summary: PSP Investments and Nuveen Real Estate launched a joint venture with an initial $790M to buy open-air shopping centers anchored by grocers, necessity retailers and essential services. The partners have closed about 3M SF across 19 properties in eight states, including two portfolios of six centers (801,000 SF) and 11 properties (1.9M SF). PSP says it is narrowing U.S. retail exposure to grocery-anchored centers that deliver inflation-linked income, a bet on daily-needs tenants and high-barrier metros.…

items.headline: Retail Vacancy Falls to 4.3% as Q3 Absorption Hits 10.5M SF
items.summary: National retail vacancy fell 10 basis points to 4.3% in Q3, while shopping center vacancy slipped to 5.4% and mall vacancy dropped 30 basis points to 8.2%. Leasing totaled 38.4M SF and net absorption hit 10.5M SF, led by general retail at 5.4M SF, with shopping centers at 3.0M SF and malls at 1.9M SF. Elevated construction and financing costs keep supply tight, with 58.1M SF under construction, and Colliers expects limited development to support measured rent growth through 2026.…

items.headline: Camera Brand Fujifilm Takes 13K SF at 210 Lafayette Street in SoHo
items.summary: A Japanese camera manufacturer is setting up shop in Manhattan’s photogenic SoHo neighborhood. Fujifilm signed a lease for 12,700 square feet at Comjem Associates ’ 210 Lafayette Street for what could be a brick-and-mortar retail location similar to stores operated by B&H or Adorama . Not much else is known about the deal, but Fujifilm’s new space between Kenmare and Spring streets will span three levels, the New York Post reported .…

items.headline: Bath & Body Works to Open 9K-SF Store in Flatiron District
items.summary: Bath & Body Works is opening a new store in Manhattan’s Flatiron District. The soap and scented lotion purveyor has signed a lease to take over the entire nearly 9,000-square-foot retail portion of 129 Fifth Avenue , according to a source with knowledge of the deal. Bath & Body Works will move into the two-level retail unit, owned by Acadia Realty Trust , in the fall of 2027, according to Crain’s New York Business , which first reported the lease.…

items.headline: Japanese Restaurant Udon Shin to Open First NYC Spot at 37 West 17th Street
items.summary: Udon Shin , a popular Japanese restaurant with only two other U.S. locations, is gearing up to open its first New York City eatery, Commercial Observer has learned. Udon Shin has signed a 10-year, 2,500-square-foot lease at 37 West 17th Street in Manhattan’s Flatiron District, according to tenant broker Aaron Gavios of Gavios Realty Group . Asking rent was $30,000 per month for the space previously occupied by now-closed Italian restaurant Basta Pasta.…

items.headline: Sports Retailer Lids to Open New Shop Inside Penn Station
items.summary: Sports apparel retailer Lids is adding another location in New York City, this time inside Midtown’s bustling Pennsylvania Station , Commercial Observer has learned. Lids, which sells sports hats, jerseys and fan apparel, has inked a 10-year, 1,993-square-foot lease for a flagship location inside the Vornado Realty Trust -managed transit hub. Lids is the largest licensed sports-minded retailer in North America, with more than 1,300 stores, according to tenant broker JLL .…

items.headline: Gerber Life Insurance Signs 13K-SF Lease at Two Trees’ 45 Main Street
items.summary: Gerber Life Insurance , the children’s life insurance provider, has signed a 12,868-square-foot office lease at Two Trees Management ’s office property at 45 Main Street in Brooklyn’s Dumbo neighborhood, Commercial Observer has learned. The new space will serve as a satellite office for Gerber Life’s technology teams, according to Two Trees. Gerber is based in White Plains, N.Y. The length of the deal and the exact asking rent were not disclosed.…

items.headline: Fintech Firm Ramp Adds Another 175K SF at 28-40 West 23rd Street
items.summary: Financial technology firm Ramp has scaled up its 28-40 West 23rd Street operations for the second time this year. The firm secured another 175,000 square feet at Williams Equities ’ Flatiron District complex, Commercial Observer has learned. The long-term lease expansion comes on the heels of a 153,300-square-foot addition inked in March — one of Manhattan’s largest first-quarter office deals .…

items.headline: Brooklyn Powerhouse Sports to Open 11K-SF Facility in Sunset Park
items.summary: Brooklyn Powerhouse Sports , a new fitness and athletic training facility, is opening its first location. Brooklyn Powerhouse has signed a 10,871-square-foot lease at Capstone Equities ’ 14 53rd Street , known as the Whale Building , near the shore of New York Harbor in Sunset Park, Commercial Observer has learned. The company will set up batting cages and a small office at the location.…

items.headline: Amazon’s Same-Day Delivery Expansion Reignites Demand for Last-Mile Logistics
items.summary: When Amazon makes moves in the delivery business, the entire retail industry tends to reorient itself around the e-commerce giant. So, when a September report from Business Insider revealed preliminary plans for Amazon to embark on a “ massive blitz in same-day delivery ” with a proposed expansion of facilities code-named Project Mercury, industrial real estate took notice.…

items.headline: Shorenstein Signs 78K SF in Office Leases at Repositioned D.C. Building
items.summary: Shorenstein announced Monday that it has secured approximately three office leases totaling 78,000 square feet at its recently repositioned building in Washington, D.C.’s East End. Policy analysis and consulting firm Capstone signed the largest lease at approximately 43,000 square feet. Government relations and lobbying firm Monument Advocacy signed for 25,000 square feet, and the nonprofit Skoll Foundation signed for 10,000 square feet, according to Avison Young , which represented Shorenstein.…
